title: Complex formation between VPS13C and Rab7
author: Dazhi Li
materials: After 48 h, harvest cells and resuspend in 10 mL buffer A (500 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.8, 10% glycerol, 1 mM TCEP) supplemented with 1 mM GTP Sodium GTP Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #G8877 and 2 mM MgCl 2 .
Analyze cross-linked VPS13C–Rab7A complexes by SDS-PAGE.

steps.title: Co‑express Rab7A and VPS13C
steps.instruction: Mix 30 µg N‑terminal Strep‑tagged Rab7A plasmid and 70 µg C‑terminal 3xFLAG‑tagged VPS13C plasmid in Opti‑MEM with Expifectamine and add to 100 mL Expi293F cells; follow the manufacturer’s transfection protocol.

steps.title: Lyse transfected cells
steps.instruction: Subject the harvested cells to three freeze–thaw cycles, then clarify the lysate by centrifugation.

steps.title: Divide lysate for pull‑downs
steps.instruction: Allocate 30 % of the clarified lysate for FLAG pull‑down and 70 % for Strep pull‑down.

steps.title: FLAG pull‑down
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL anti‑FLAG M2 resin to the 30 % lysate fraction, incubate 2 h at 4 °C; wash resin four times with 15 mL buffer A; elute bound proteins three times with 50 µL buffer A containing 0.5 mg/mL FLAG peptide, incubating 20 min for each elution.

steps.title: Strep pull‑down
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Strep‑Tactin XT 4Flow high‑capacity resin to the 70 % lysate fraction, incubate 2 h at 4 °C; wash resin four times with 15 mL buffer A; elute bound proteins three times with 50 µL buffer A containing 50 mM D‑biotin, incubating 20 min for each elution.

steps.title: Detect VPS13C‑VAB domain
steps.instruction: Perform anti‑FLAG western blot on the VPS13C‑VAB domain eluates to detect co‑purified protein (Coomassie staining is unreliable).

steps.title: Quantify VPS13C binding
steps.instruction: Normalize the intensity of each co‑purified VPS13C band to its corresponding Rab7A band, then normalize those values to the full‑length VPS13C control.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE analysis
steps.instruction: Run Strep pull‑down eluates on SDS‑PAGE: resolve Rab7A on a 4–20 % Tris‑glycine gel and co‑purified VPS13C on a 3–8 % Tris‑acetate gel.

steps.title: Pool and concentrate eluates
steps.instruction: Combine the eluates and concentrate them to a final volume of 50 µL.

steps.title: Express MBP‑Rab7A‑6xHis
steps.instruction: Transfect Expi293F cells with the MBP‑TEV‑Rab7A‑6xHis construct, harvest, lyse by three freeze–thaw cycles, and clarify the lysate.

steps.title: Mix VPS13C and MBP‑Rab7A
steps.instruction: Combine purified full‑length VPS13C‑3xFLAG with MBP‑Rab7A‑6xHis at a 1:10 molar ratio and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cross‑link proteins
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 % glutaraldehyde to VPS13C alone, Rab7A alone, and the VPS13C + Rab7A mixture; incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench cross‑linking
steps.instruction: Add 100 mM Tris, pH 8.0, to each reaction and incubate 10 min at room temperature to quench the glutaraldehyde.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Run the pooled eluates on a Superose 6 column equilibrated in buffer B (200 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.2, 6 % glycerol, 1 mM TCEP) to remove maltose.

steps.title: MBP pull‑down
steps.instruction: Incubate clarified lysate with Amylose resin for 2 h at 4 °C; wash the resin; elute bound protein with buffer A supplemented with 50 mM maltose. Apply this MBP pull‑down procedure to all samples as described.
